name: Viridescent-Howe
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by massive canyon systems. Beyond an orbital debris ring, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Whoever controls water controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
